description: The Area Agency on Aging for this county: the local door to information and assistance, meals, caregiver support, in-home services and long-term care case management.
next_step: Call with the county and what is hard right now. Ask for information and assistance or an assessment. Military service is not required.
constraints: Many services focus on people age 60 and older, tribal members 55 and older, adults with disabilities and their caregivers; eligibility varies by service.
Tribal elders can also contact the Yakama Nation Area Agency on Aging (509-865-7164) or the Colville Indian Area Agency on Aging (509-634-2759).
